proposedOverrides.summary: Modern Israel, its institutions, immigrant and local communities, science, family life and conflict; the atlas incorrectly starts in 1938 and includes occupied Palestinian territory.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: Exact modern ID only. Imported 1938 to open; six geometries 1938 to 1945, 1945 to 1960, 1960 to 1994, 1994 to 2000, 2000 to 2010, 2010 to 2020. All contain Gaza City, Ramallah, Hebron and East Jerusalem as well as Tel Aviv, Haifa and Eilat; Quneitra/Golan test point, Taba and Amman outside. Public warning explicitly rejects outline as sovereignty/current-control or pre-1967 map. No aliases or merging Mandatory Palestine, Canaan, ancient Israel or Palestinian identity. Current events scoped to sources available 23 September 2026; dated examples and institutional legal attribution, no speculative national fall.
